notes.content: [p][b]Robbotto now fully supports the Steamdeck![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally:[/p][list][*][p]Major changes in the game's difficulty. notes.title: The game is out!
notes.content: Alright, the game is now released!

notes.title: For reviewers - Last minute bug fixes
notes.content:
Just wanted to give a quick note; during a final playthrough some last minute, potentially game-breaking bugs were found and fixed, most notably on Level 77 (where the enemies could accidentally go down a level) and on Level 92 (where the long-jump didn't work on a gamepad).

Everything should be in order now, before the official release.
